description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Unix Socket connections within the Orleans TestingHost framework, focusing on registering connection factories and listeners via dependency injection.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods for configuring Unix Socket connections within Orleans' silo and client builders.

methods.name: UseUnixSocketConnection (ISiloBuilder)
methods.description: Adds Unix Socket connection factories and listeners to the silo's service collection.

methods.name: UseUnixSocketConnection (IClientBuilder)
methods.description: Adds Unix Socket connection factory to the client builder's service collection.

methods.name: CreateUnixSocketConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory method that produces UnixSocketConnectionFactory instances.

methods.name: CreateUnixSocketConnectionListenerFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory method that produces UnixSocketConnectionListenerFactory instances.
